_doc: Per-device final defaults for Nioh3EngineFix.ini. make_profiles.py applies these overrides to mod\Nioh3EngineFix\Nioh3EngineFix.ini
(comments kept) and writes release\profiles\Nioh3EngineFix.<DEVICE>.ini. Keys not listed keep the base ini value.
status: kept = measured on that device (or shipped there and stable) and safe as a default;
provisional = recommended but its live A/B on that device is still open (flip to kept/drop after the final re-test);
off = deliberately off on this device (measured loss, neutral, or not a default).
Edit this file when a matrix verdict lands (tools\testmatrix verdict_<dev>.md), then run make_profiles.py and check_release.py.
